verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking SaaS, so a public interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack shows no API reference, developer docs, or runnable examples. It documents only app features, accounting-software syncs, Plaid connections, and an llms.txt support file, none of which is an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
